clue.text: Master rearranged pupils' grouping

indicators.note: rearranged tells us the letters of the word Master are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A head teacher has reshuffled the way the school's classes are organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Master' looks like the teacher doing the rearranging, but it is the fodder for the anagram signalled by 'rearranged'.
explanation.definitionFit: Schools that sort children by ability put them into streams, so a stream is a set or band of pupils.

clue.text: After remarkable tour, record set up for group of players

indicators.note: After places the record piece behind the tour letters
remarkable here means re-markable, so the letters of tour are marked out anew
set up in a down clue means the word for a record is read upwards

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Following a great tour, a band put out a new record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remarkable' is read as re-markable, so the tour is shuffled; 'set up' turns the record upwards, as suits a down clue, and 'After' places it behind.
explanation.definitionFit: A troupe is a company of actors or performers.

clue.text: Enlarges old maps taking in island

parts.note: ex means former or old

indicators.note: taking in means enclosing, so the maps word goes round the island letter

parts.note: plans are maps or drawings of a place

explanation.surface: Someone blows up antique charts to include an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking in' puts I inside PLANS. 'Enlarges' as in enlarges on a point: goes into detail.
explanation.definitionFit: To enlarge on a topic is to expand and clarify it.

clue.text: Wrongly label motorway crossing-point, trapping traffic initially

parts.note: the M1 motorway, written MI in crosswords

indicators.note: trapping means catching inside, so the stile word holds the next letter

parts.note: a stile is steps for crossing a fence

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of traffic

explanation.surface: A badly named motorway junction holds up the vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trapping' puts T inside STILE. The M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, from London to Leeds.
explanation.definitionFit: To mistitle is to give something an incorrect name.

clue.text: No longer successful, did kitchen work

definitions.meaning: a has-been, finished, whose career is over
cleaned the plates and pans after a meal

explanation.definitionFit: One phrase means both finished as a success and having cleaned the dishes after eating.

clue.text: Look out for invasion by airborne forces brought up for combat

indicators.note: invasion by says the air force letters break into the warning word

parts.note: ware is an old word for beware, look out

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue means read upwards

parts.note: RAF is the Royal Air Force

explanation.surface: Be alert to paratroopers raised for battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns the air force upwards into FAR, and 'invasion by' sends it into the old warning word.
explanation.definitionFit: Warfare is armed conflict, fighting between forces.

clue.text: Husband's rage over unwelcome dependant

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband
anger is fury
on means on top of, over

explanation.surface: A man fumes about a sponger who won't leave.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a hanger-on: a follower clinging to someone for gain.

clue.text: Requires a mission statement

parts.note: requires here means asks for; a returning pilot or agent is asked for a report on the mission

explanation.definitionFit: Debriefing is questioning someone after an operation to get an account of what happened.

clue.text: A little money requiring direct investment in such shares

indicators.note: investment in means one piece is clothed inside another

parts.note: pence are small coins, a little money
to refer someone is to direct them

explanation.surface: Shares bought for a small sum need cash put straight into them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'investment in' is used in the clothing sense: one word dressed inside another. Preference shares are a real class of stock.
explanation.definitionFit: Preference shares are a class of stock paying a fixed dividend ahead of ordinary holders.

clue.text: Business having problem about marks for Berlin, say

indicators.note: about means going round, so the first pieces surround the next one

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business
a poser is a puzzling problem
M is the abbreviation for marks, the old German currency

explanation.surface: A firm runs into trouble over Deutschmarks in the German capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the firm and the problem round M. Berlin is not the city but Irving Berlin, the American songwriter.
explanation.definitionFit: Irving Berlin wrote songs such as White Christmas, making him an example of a music writer.

clue.text: French articles about a bishop lacking power

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the French words enclose the rest

parts.note: un and le are French words for a and the
B is the chess notation abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Some pieces of French writing on a churchman are judged ineffective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts UN and LE on either side of A and B.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lacking power to do a thing is incapable of it.

clue.text: Demand parking in a small Parisian enclosure

indicators.note: in, together with enclosure, says one piece sits within another
enclosure says the French phrase forms a pen round the parking letter

parts.note: taken as written
petite is the French word for small, as a Parisian would say it
P is the abbreviation for parking, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a parking space in a tiny walled yard in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'enclosure' put P inside A PETITE.
explanation.definitionFit: Appetite as in public appetite for a product is the desire or call for it, which is demand.

clue.text: Arbitrator means to get to right conclusion

indicators.note: conclusion says the right letter comes at the end

parts.note: media are means of communication, the plural of medium
taken as written

explanation.surface: A referee is someone who has ways of reaching the correct verdict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conclusion' places R at the end of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbitrator is a go-between who settles disputes, which is what a mediator does.

clue.text: Like Parliament in recess still

definitions.meaning: with no proposals put for debate while the chamber is closed

explanation.definitionFit: Without movement, unmoving; and a parliament off for holidays has no proposals before it.

clue.text: Opening of port in sample for barman

indicators.note: in says the letter goes inside the word for a sample

parts.note: a taster is a small sample of something

indicators.note: opening of means take just the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A bartender tries a little of the port as it is opened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts P, the first letter of 'port', inside TASTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapster is an old word for someone who draws beer in an inn, a bartender.

clue.text: Introduction of energy into quiet walk

parts.note: P is piano, quiet in music

indicators.note: into says the energy letter goes inside

parts.note: a ramble is a country walk
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Adding some vigour to a gentle stroll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts E inside P and RAMBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A preamble is an opening statement before the main text.

clue.text: E.g. Victoria's semester?

definitions.meaning: Victoria is a London railway station where lines end
semester is the American word, so read as a term in the States

explanation.walkthrough: Victoria is a mainline London station where trains end their journey; the question mark flags the cryptic second reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the end station of a line; split, it reads as a term in America.

clue.text: In bones being broken, such a blessing in disguise

indicators.note: being broken says the letters of the words In and bones are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A broken bone turns out to be a hidden good fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being broken' scrambles the first two words together; 'such a' and 'in disguise' are surface padding around the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Benison is an old literary word for a benediction or blessing.

clue.text: Shamefully unhorsed, take cover and hide

indicators.note: shamefully hints at disgrace, so the letters of unhorsed are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A rider disgracefully thrown from the saddle runs to hide.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shamefully' rearranges UNHORSED.
explanation.definitionFit: To enshroud is to wrap in a burial sheet, concealing completely.

clue.text: Angry doctor falls in water

indicators.note: falls in says one piece drops inside another

parts.note: irate means angry
to doctor results is to rig or falsify them

explanation.surface: A furious physician tumbles into the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falls in' drops one piece inside the other. 'doctor' is a verb here, not a physician.
explanation.definitionFit: To irrigate fields is to supply them with water.

clue.text: Way to achieve a particular shape

explanation.definitionFit: Means both a manner of doing and to form or mould something.

clue.text: Deep strait sailor has to operate across

indicators.note: across means stretched over, so the sailor and operating words lie either side

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a sailor
to use something is to operate it
STR is an abbreviation for strait, as on maps

explanation.surface: A seaman must work a ship over a deep channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'across' puts AB and USE on either side of STR. 'Deep' looks like it describes the strait but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep in the sense of profound and hard to understand is obscure.

clue.text: Run to take part in smart procession

indicators.note: to take part in says the run letter joins within the smarting word

parts.note: to smart is to sting
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone runs to join a fashionable parade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take part in' puts R inside STING. 'smart' is the pain sense, not stylish.
explanation.definitionFit: A string of people or things is a line of them, like a procession.

clue.text: Approach to young lady making impact? Not quite

parts.note: to near a place is to approach it
a miss is a girl or young lady

explanation.surface: Someone chats up a girl and almost makes an impression.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the question mark: a hit that did not quite happen.
explanation.definitionFit: A near miss is something that almost collides but fails to strike, a narrowly avoided collision.

clue.text: In recession, making more land accessible

definitions.meaning: going back or receding, as the tide does
as the sea goes out, more shore is exposed to walk on

explanation.definitionFit: A tide going out recedes and uncovers more beach, so both phrases describe the falling tide.

clue.text: One of the Romans thus protecting old barrier under constant pressure

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: protecting means wrapping round, so the Latin word surrounds the next pieces

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus
a bar is a barrier

explanation.surface: A Roman soldier guards an ancient wall while under great strain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protecting' wraps the Latin word round the old barrier. Isobaric lines on a weather map join places of equal pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Isobaric is the physics term for a process or line at uniform pressure.

clue.text: His customers may spread the beginnings of panic

definitions.text: His customers may spread the beginnings of panic

parts.words: His customers may spread the beginnings of panic
parts.note: the seeds of panic are its beginnings; a trader whose buyers sow seeds is the person meant

explanation.definitionFit: A seedsman sells seeds to gardeners and farmers who sow them.

clue.text: Doctor has to move carefully to operate on bed

parts.note: to edge is to inch forward cautiously

explanation.surface: A surgeon must go gently when operating on a patient lying down.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed is a river bed or sea bed, not a hospital bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Dredging scoops mud and silt from the floor of a river or harbour.
